card.name: Ethyl inside chemical names
card.fires_on: The piece 'ethyl' or 'yl' in 'ethyl' (as in ethyl alcohol, ethyl vinyl acetate) and 'ethyl' inside 'diethylpropion' or 'diethylcarbamazine'. It fires as the word is being spelled out, before the rest of the chemical name.
